system.description: A combination Discipline that slows enemies' perceptions, leaving their image of you a fraction of a second behind your actual position and making your movements nearly impossible to anticipate. Spend an additional Blood Trait when you activate Celerity for the turn; your Swiftness action for the turn must be evasive movement. For every attack against you this turn that you respond to with an evasion rather than a counterattack, you gain 2 bonus Traits. This power is treated as an Obfuscate power for purposes of negation; an observer with sufficient Auspex, or one viewing you through a camera or other electronic intermediary, is immune to it. Costs 6 Experience Traits to learn.
system.bloodCost: 1 additional Blood Trait when activating Celerity
